messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: HeliosCorp dedicated pool bring-up scheduled Wed 2026-05-06 20:00 UTC. Need quota sign-off, autoscale policy, quick load test, and a renewal note. Who can own?
Luca (Ops): I can run ops. Customer asked for 3 reserved A100s with burst to 6. I'll re-check regional quotas and slot allocations.
Sam (SE): Model pinned to rdm-v3-small. Recommend batch target 24, max_delay 8ms. I'll bake a warm-cache trace generator for their conversational prompts.
Riley (SRE): Suggest 25m pre-warm to populate prefix KV. Autoscale: scale-up at 75% GPU util sustained 45s, scale-down after 180s under 40%. I'll add alerts for errors >0.4% over 5m.
Theo (AM): I'll manage customer comms and renewal tie-in. Success criteria: p95 < 250ms, errors <0.2%, cost within 10% estimate. Will get written quota sign-off.
Luca (Ops): Proposed runbook: 1) Reserve nodes + deploy model 2) 25m warmup with helio-traces.json 3) Ramp to 70% target QPS for 15m 4) 15m soak 5) handover. Load command: ./lt --target helios --rps 480 --concurrency 90 --duration 30m --seed helio-traces.json
Deploy Bot: pool "helios-dedicated" -> resized to 5 nodes (3 reserved + 2 buffer) at 2026-05-05T16:12:03Z
Priya (CS): Feedback: post-soak we'll send a 2-question form and include a short handover checklist. I'll draft customer-facing schedule after dry-run.
Sam (SE): Adding a 2k-token long story case to traces (quant fallback check). I'll push config patch to staging and share diff.
Riley (SRE): I'll create the incident stub and a dashboard snapshot link for the customer to view during the last 10m.
Priya (CS): Owners: Luca=ops lead, Sam=SE config, Riley=SRE monitoring, Theo=account. Dry-run planned tomorrow 18:30 UTC. Any blockers?
Luca (Ops): None. Running dry-run and will report results here.
Theo (AM): All set. I'll prep renewal note and invite customer to final 10m of soak.
Priya (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: — will post final schedule after dry-run.
